title: Maximum Subarray Sum with One Deletion
goal: Find the maximum nonempty subarray sum after at most one deletion.
strategy: Maintain states ending here with no deletion and with one deletion. The latter either extends a prior deleted state or deletes the current value from the previous kept state.
